newsitem.title: CHILE: CTC, VTR merger talks continue - CTC.
newsitem.headline: CTC, VTR merger talks continue - CTC.

text.p: Talks between Compania de Telecomunicaciones de Chile and telecom VTR towards a possible merger are continuing, with no definitive agreement reached yet, CTC President Claudio Garcia said.
Garcia called Reuters in Santiago to clarify statements he made earlier Tuesday to a group of reporters at a trade show.
At the time, Garcia said he believed an agreement had been reached in the talks, but that there were still "minimal" chances of disagreement.
"The possibilities of disagreement are minimal. The agreement has been reached," he told reporters at the time.

Garcia later clarified that he did not mean that negotiations were over. The talks are being carried out between Telefonica de Espana's international unit Telefonica Internacional (TISA), owner of 44 percent of CTC, and VTR's majority owners, the Luksic group of Chile.
"At no time did I say that the negotiations are finished," he said.

He said that the progress of the talks was a matter for the owners of both companies to comment on and reiterated statements by CTC's general manager, Jacinto Diaz, who said that negotiations continued.
Diaz said on Friday that the percentages of stock participation by both companies in the merger had been settled and that an end to the negotiations was nearing.
